Analyzes command metrics and pushes a digest to agent_feed so seats can
self-direct.

This command satisfies CAP metrics-plane directive feeder facets
(GLS-1786416188034709000).

  Push metrics digest
  zqk system metrics feed

Usage:
  zqk system metrics feed [flags]

Flags:
      --agent-id string   Agent ID for the feed sender (default "kernel-metrics-feeder")
      --notify            Queue IDE proof of life (notify) (default true)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
